meta.description: The corpus frequencies behind the paper's probabilistic anaphora example (John gave the bananas to the monkeys. They were ripe. They were cheeky.): the British News corpus counts of the four adjective-noun patterns, and the printed distribution over the four candidate gluings. Locations are sections of the arXiv preprint (1403.3351v1).
